reader_summary.overview: Today I am joined by Yanev Suissa, Managing Partner at SineWave Ventures, to break down the private company Databricks. Born out of a UC Berkeley research lab in 2013, Databricks has grown rapidly, and after 50% growth this summer. In the most simple terms, Databricks provides tools for ingesting, transforming.
